SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.title as content, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName,
( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM my_liked_vlog m WHERE m.vlog_id = v.id AND m.user_id = #{paramMap.userId} ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as doILikeThisVlog,
( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fans f WHERE f.fan_id = #{paramMap.userId} AND f.vloger_id = v.vloger_id ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as doIFollowVloger
FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0
AND v.title like CONCAT('%', #{paramMap.search}, '%')
ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as id, v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.nickname as vlogerName, u.face as vlogerFace, v.title as content, v.cover as cover, v.url as url, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate,
-- 🌟 子查询：判断当前用户是否点赞了这个视频 (SELECT count(1) FROM my_liked_vlog m WHERE m.vlog_id = v.id AND m.user_id = #{currentUserId}) as doILikeThisVlog,
-- 🌟 子查询：判断当前用户是否关注了这个博主 (SELECT count(1) FROM fans f WHERE f.fan_id = #{currentUserId} AND f.vloger_id = v.vloger_id) as doIFollowVloger
FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.vloger_id = #{vlogerId} AND v.is_private = #{isPrivate} ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as id, v.id as vlogId, v.cover as cover, v.url as url FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN my_liked_vlog m ON v.id = m.vlog_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND (v.is_private = 0 OR v.vloger_id = #{currentUserId}) ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.nickname as vlogerName, u.face as vlogerFace, v.title as content, v.cover as cover, v.url as url, v.is_private as isPrivate, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, (SELECT count(1) FROM my_liked_vlog m WHERE m.vlog_id = v.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}) as doILikeThisVlog, (SELECT count(1) FROM fans f WHERE f.fan_id = #{userId} AND f.vloger_id = v.vloger_id) as doIFollowVloger FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{vlogId} AND (v.is_private = 0 OR v.vloger_id = #{userId})

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.title as content, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName,
( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM my_liked_vlog m WHERE m.vlog_id = v.id AND m.user_id = #{myId} ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as doILikeThisVlog,
1 as doIFollowVloger
FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0
AND v.vloger_id IN ( SELECT vloger_id FROM fans WHERE fan_id = #{myId} ) ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.title as content, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName,
( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM my_liked_vlog m WHERE m.vlog_id = v.id AND m.user_id = #{myId} ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as doILikeThisVlog,
1 as doIFollowVloger
FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0
AND v.vloger_id IN ( SELECT f1.vloger_id FROM fans f1 INNER JOIN fans f2 ON f1.vloger_id = f2.fan_id AND f1.fan_id = f2.vloger_id WHERE f1.fan_id = #{myId} ) ORDER BY v.created_time DESC
